name: Nomenjanahary Zo DIMBINDRAINY
headline: Cybersecurity Architect & Cloud Engineer
paragraphs: I am a security-oriented engineer specialized in building resilient digital infrastructures.
My work sits at the intersection of cybersecurity, cloud architecture, and secure application development.
Security is not a feature — it is the foundation of every system I design.
I integrate monitoring, automation, Zero Trust principles, and performance optimization into every deployment.
